UserAgent.name: get_exposure_stream
UserAgent.description: Per simulation step: request algorithm recommendations (GetAlgorithmRecommendationEvent), deliver pending @/propagation notifications (MentionEvent), replay keep-following posts (BookmarkEvent), and build social follow feed (SocialRecommendationEvent). Updates last_login_timestamp after social scan.

required_variables.name: current_posts
required_variables.description: Posts visible in the current time window (from StartEvent / env.current_posts).

required_variables.name: mentions
required_variables.description: Pending @/repost/quote/reply notifications for this user (from env.mention_pool via StartEvent).

required_variables.name: follow_ids
required_variables.description: Followed user IDs for social feed filtering.

required_variables.name: recommended_post_ids
required_variables.description: Post IDs already seen; used to skip duplicates in social feed.

required_variables.name: bookmark_post_ids
required_variables.description: Post IDs to re-expose next round after LLM keep-following decision.

output_updates.name: last_login_timestamp
output_updates.description: Updated after social feed scan (Unix seconds).

UserAgent.name: generate_memory_from_own_posts
UserAgent.description: Reflect on own posts published in the current step window and generate self-memory via LLM.

required_variables.name: current_posts
required_variables.description: Current post window; filtered to posts authored by this user in [lo, hi).

UserAgent.name: supplement_own_posts
UserAgent.description: Decide whether to add a supplementary comment on own posts from the last 14 days. Re-review a post only if never reviewed or its comment count changed (no mention notifications).

required_variables.name: current_posts
required_variables.description: Current post window; filtered to this user's posts in the last 14 days.

output_updates.name: content_pool
output_updates.description: May gain new comments on own posts.

UserAgent.name: receive_recommendation
UserAgent.condition: Triggered by SocialRecommendationEvent, AlgorithmRecommendationEvent, SearchResultEvent, or BookmarkEvent
UserAgent.description: Consume recommended posts from social/algorithm/search/keep-following channels; run UserAgentGates + LLM to decide reposts, quotes, replies, @mentions, keep-following, and search; write propagation posts to content_pool and mention_pool.

required_variables.name: recommendations
required_variables.description: Batch of post_id -> post dict from the incoming recommendation event.

required_variables.name: recommended_post_ids
required_variables.description: Historical recommended post IDs on profile.

required_variables.name: follow_ids
required_variables.description: For mentionable-user resolution.

required_variables.name: fan_ids
required_variables.description: For mentionable-user resolution.

required_variables.name: content_pool
required_variables.description: Full post pool for chain hints, depth gates, and parent lookup.

required_variables.name: seed_root_post_ids
required_variables.description: Frozen env seed root post IDs for PostDepthGate hop limits.

output_updates.name: content_pool
output_updates.description: New repost/quote/reply entries appended as top-level post_id keys.

output_updates.name: bookmark_post_ids
output_updates.description: At most one post ID carried to next round.

UserAgent.name: handle_mention
UserAgent.description: Process @/repost/quote/reply notifications: LLM decides whether to propagate or search; writes posts via AddPostEvent and updates mention_pool; may trigger GetSearchResultEvent.

required_variables.name: mentions
required_variables.description: post_id -> {post, mention_type} enriched from mention_pool.

required_variables.name: follow_ids
required_variables.description: For relationship hints and @ resolution.

required_variables.name: fan_ids
required_variables.description: For relationship hints and @ resolution.

required_variables.name: content_pool
required_variables.description: Post pool for context and depth gates.

required_variables.name: seed_root_post_ids
required_variables.description: Env seed roots for PostDepthGate.

output_updates.name: mention_pool
output_updates.description: Processed mentions removed; new notifications added.

Algorithm.name: update_current_posts
Algorithm.description: Sync Algorithm profile current_posts from StartEvent for random/popularity/interest recommendation and search candidate pools.

required_variables.name: current_posts
required_variables.description: Current post window from StartEvent.

output_updates.name: current_posts
output_updates.description: Algorithm profile mirror of env current_posts.

Algorithm.name: send_recommendation_results
Algorithm.description: Run random / popularity / interest recommendation for requesting user; return AlgorithmRecommendationEvent with sampled post batch.

required_variables.name: current_posts
required_variables.description: Candidate post pool for this step.

required_variables.name: user_profile
required_variables.description: Requesting UserAgent profile payload.

required_variables.name: recommended_post_ids
required_variables.description: Posts already recommended to this user (dedup input).

required_variables.name: type
required_variables.description: Optional algorithm type. Empty: Algorithm uses exposure.recommendation.types from params.

required_variables.name: candidate_post_ids_by_user
required_variables.description: Interest recommendation per-user candidate lists.

Algorithm.name: send_search_results
Algorithm.description: Run relevant search over current_posts for the query; return SearchResultEvent.

required_variables.name: current_posts
required_variables.description: Search corpus.

required_variables.name: user_profile
required_variables.description: Requesting user profile.

required_variables.name: search_keyword
required_variables.description: Keyword from UserAgent LLM decision.

required_variables.name: type
required_variables.description: Search type, e.g. Relevant Search.

Platform.name: register_services
Platform.description: Remember recommendation/search Algorithm ids from StartEvent. No ranking.

Platform.name: route_recommendation
Platform.description: Forward the recommendation request to the recommendation Algorithm. No ranking.

Platform.name: route_search
Platform.description: Forward the search request to the search Algorithm. No ranking.
